Kazi Tanjim Shakib (GitHub: Shakib053) is a Senior Software Engineer working at
Samsung R&D Institute Bangladesh Ltd. in Dhaka, Bangladesh. His GitHub profile

describes him as an iOS App Developer with expertise in Xcode and a Problem
Solver background. He has 33 public repositories spanning competitive programming,
native iOS development (Swift/SwiftUI), full-stack web development (React, Node.js,

MongoDB), and AI/ML (RAG systems). His work demonstrates a clear progression from
front-end HTML/CSS websites through full-stack React applications to native iOS
apps and most recently AI-powered tooling.

Primary Language: Python
Category: Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning / RAG
Last Updated: 2026-06-22

Description:
A lightweight, local Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline built with
LangChain. This project showcases how to build a fully local RAG workflow without
requiring cloud-hosted inference or a server API. The application runs entirely

in the terminal, providing a command-line interface for ingesting documents and
querying them using natural language.

Technologies Used:
- Python
- LangChain (document ingestion, vector search, chat-based generation)
- Local vector store (no cloud dependency)
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture

Key Features:
- Local document ingestion pipeline
- Vector search for semantic retrieval
- Chat-based generation using LangChain
- Runs fully in the terminal (CLI-based interface)
- Designed as a local RAG demo without needing a web backend

Purpose / What Was Built:
Shakib built this project to explore and demonstrate the LangChain RAG workflow
locally. It combines document loading, embedding, vector similarity search, and
LLM-based question answering in a self-contained terminal application.
Tags: RAG, LangChain, Python, AI, local-LLM, vector-search, retrieval-augmented-generation
